source.original_text: Let d,q∈ℕ satisfy 2q+1<d and set r=q+1, D=ℝ^d and E=ℝ^r with Euclidean norms. Let Ω=D^r and let μ=γ_d^⊗r be the original unconditional product of r standard d-dimensional Gaussian laws. Write ω=(ω_b)_{b=0}^q. For source row i=1,…,d, put Φ_i(ω)=(ω_b(i))_{b=0}^q, θ_i=(i−1/2)π/d, t_i=(1,√2 cos(θ_i),…,√2 cos(qθ_i)), and L=2r+3log(1000d). Define the real r²-by-r² matrix Y_i(ω)=d^(-1)(Φ_i(ω)Φ_i(ω)ᵀ⊗t_it_iᵀ) if ‖Φ_i(ω)‖²≤L and Y_i(ω)=0 otherwise. The first Kronecker index is the Gaussian coordinate and the second is the feature coordinate. Let M_i=∫Y_i dμ, Z_i=Y_i−M_i, ρ=2r(L+1)/d, w_i=cos((2q+1)θ_i), and X_i(ω)=ρ^(-1)w_iZ_i(ω). Then for every real s>0 and every row i, exp((exp(s)−s−1)∫X_i(ω)X_i(ω)dμ)−∫exp(sX_i(ω))dμ is positive semidefinite. All integrals use this same original μ; the cutoff includes equality and the means are the actual unconditional Bochner means. The case q=0 is included. The only dimension premise is 2q+1<d; all regularity, centering, positive scale and weighted cap facts are proved inside the private consumer. This is an authored intermediate specialization for the Gaussian weighted Bernstein use context, not a separately numbered source result or public theorem node.

decoder_context: Matrix is the finite real square-matrix algebra. Matrix multiplication is ordinary multiplication, scalar multiplication is real scalar multiplication, and 1 is the identity matrix.

For a real square matrix, IsHermitian means that its transpose equals itself. PosSemidef means full positive semidefiniteness, including self-adjointness and nonnegativity of the quadratic form on every real vector; it is not entrywise order.

NormedSpace.exp is the convergent matrix-algebra power-series exponential, not entrywise exponential. Real.exp is the scalar exponential. The matrix norm topology is the real Euclidean operator-norm topology.

Fin n is the finite set of natural numbers less than n, with zero-based i.val. EuclideanSpace real (Fin n) has its Euclidean norm and Borel structure. WithLp.toLp 2 and WithLp.ofLp wrap and unwrap the same coordinates.

stdGaussian is the centered Gaussian probability measure with identity covariance. Measure.pi is the displayed finite product measure on the function space. No conditioning is implicit in a displayed measure or integral.
Real.log is the natural logarithm and Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root. Real inverses are totalized at zero. A cutoff using less-than-or-equal includes equality.
Matrix.vecMulVec u v has entry u_i v_j. The Kronecker product has entry A_(i,k) B_(j,l) at paired row (i,j) and column (k,l), with exactly the displayed factor order.

Integrals are Bochner integrals in the finite matrix space, totalized to zero for nonintegrable functions. Reconstruct the proposition as written without adding integrability premises or conclusions. Each let definition scopes over the full following proposition.

/-! The real normalized single-matrix expectation MGF step of Tropp Lemma 6.7.
Regularity expands his section 2.2 standing convention. This is not a sum tail.
-/
open MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators Matrix.Norms.L2Operator MatrixOrder
noncomputable section
universe u v
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixBernsteinMgf

private lemma capped_matrix_exp_norm_le
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hcap : (1 - A).PosSemidef)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : ‖NormedSpace.exp (s • A)‖ ≤ Real.exp s := by
  have hSA : IsSelfAdjoint A := hA.isSelfAdjoint
  have hspec : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, x ≤ 1 :=
    (CFC.le_one_iff (R := ℝ) A hSA).mp (Matrix.le_iff.mpr hcap)
  have heq : cfc (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (s * x)) A = NormedSpace.exp (s • A) := by
    calc
      _ = cfc Real.exp (s • A) := cfc_comp_const_mul s Real.exp A (by fun_prop) hSA
      _ = _ := CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp ((IsSelfAdjoint.all s).smul hSA)
  rw [← heq]
  apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_nonneg s)
  intro x hx
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hspec x hx) hs.le

private lemma exp_sub_one_add_posSemidef
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (NormedSpace.exp A - (1 + A)).PosSemidef := by
  have hSA : IsSelfAdjoint A := hA.isSelfAdjoint
  have hfc : cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x) A ≤ cfc Real.exp A :=
    cfc_mono (a := A) (fun x _ => by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp x])
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have hlin : cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x) A = (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) + A := by
    rw [cfc_add (a := A) (fun _ : ℝ => 1) (fun x : ℝ => x) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
      cfc_const (R := ℝ) 1 A hSA, cfc_id' ℝ A hSA, map_one]
  exact Matrix.le_iff.mp
    (by simpa only [hlin, CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp hSA] using hfc)

/-- Real normalized bounded Bernstein MGF, with almost-sure one-sided cap. -/
theorem centered_bounded_matrix_mgf
    {Ω : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (X : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    (hintX : Integrable X μ)
    (hintSq : Integrable (fun ω => X ω * X ω) μ)
    (hherm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (hcap : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (1 - X ω).PosSemidef)
    (hzero : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) = 0)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (NormedSpace.exp ((Real.exp s - s - 1) • (∫ ω, X ω * X ω ∂μ)) -
      ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ).PosSemidef
 := by
  classical
  let M := Matrix ι ι ℝ
  let g : ℝ := Real.exp s - s - 1
  let C : M := g • (∫ ω, X ω * X ω ∂μ)
  have hcontExp : Continuous (NormedSpace.exp : M → M) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun A =>
      (NormedSpace.exp_analytic (𝕂 := ℝ) A).continuousAt
  have hmeasExp : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω)) μ :=
    hcontExp.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hX.const_smul s)
  have hintExp : Integrable (fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω)) μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound hmeasExp (Real.exp s)
    filter_upwards [hherm, hcap] with ω hh hc
    exact capped_matrix_exp_norm_le _ hh hc hs
  have hsqPSD : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω * X ω).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [hherm] with ω hh
    have heq : Matrix.conjTranspose (X ω) = X ω := hh
    simpa only [heq] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (X ω)
  have hcovPSD :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveIntegral.integral_posSemidef
      (fun ω => X ω * X ω) hintSq hsqPSD
  have hg : 0 ≤ g := by dsimp only [g]; linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp s]
  have hCPSD : C.PosSemidef := hcovPSD.smul hg
  let Q : Ω → M := fun ω => (1 : M) + s • X ω + g • (X ω * X ω)
  let F : Ω → M := fun ω => Q ω - NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω)
  have hintOne : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => (1 : M)) μ := integrable_const _
  have honeMean : (∫ _ : Ω, (1 : M) ∂μ) = 1 := by simp
  have hintQ : Integrable Q μ := (hintOne.add (hintX.smul s)).add (hintSq.smul g)
  have hintF : Integrable F μ := hintQ.sub hintExp
  have hQmean : (∫ ω, Q ω ∂μ) = (1 : M) + C := by
    dsimp only [Q, C]
    have hsum :
        (∫ ω, (1 : M) + s • X ω + g • (X ω * X ω) ∂μ) =
          (∫ ω, (1 : M) + s • X ω ∂μ) + (∫ ω, g • (X ω * X ω) ∂μ) := by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply] using
        integral_add (hintOne.add (hintX.smul s)) (hintSq.smul g)
    have hsumOne :
        (∫ ω, (1 : M) + s • X ω ∂μ) =
          (∫ _ : Ω, (1 : M) ∂μ) + (∫ ω, s • X ω ∂μ) := by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply] using integral_add hintOne (hintX.smul s)
    rw [hsum, hsumOne, integral_smul s X,
      integral_smul g (fun ω => X ω * X ω), honeMean, hzero]
    simp only [smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hFmean : (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ) = (1 : M) + C - ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ := by
    change (∫ ω, Q ω - NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ) = _
    rw [integral_sub hintQ hintExp, hQmean]
  have hFPSD : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (F ω).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [hherm, hcap] with ω hh hc
    exact AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixBernsteinExponential.bernstein_exponential_quadratic_bound
      (X ω) hh hc hs
  have hupperPSD :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveIntegral.integral_posSemidef
      F hintF hFPSD
  rw [hFmean] at hupperPSD
  have hlowerPSD := exp_sub_one_add_posSemidef C hCPSD.isHermitian
  change (NormedSpace.exp C - ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ).PosSemidef
  have halg : NormedSpace.exp C - (∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ) =
      (NormedSpace.exp C - (1 + C)) +
        ((1 + C) - ∫ ω, NormedSpace.exp (s • X ω) ∂μ) := by abel
  rw [halg]
  exact hlowerPSD.add hupperPSD

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixBernsteinMgf

canonical_public_producer_context.statement: Let (Ω,Σ,μ) be a probability space, let I be a finite nonempty index set, and let X:Ω→Mat_I(ℝ). Give real matrices the Euclidean operator-norm topology and use the Bochner integral and matrix-algebra power-series exponential. Suppose X is almost-everywhere strongly measurable, X and the ordinary matrix square X² are integrable, X=Xᵀ almost everywhere, I−X is positive semidefinite almost everywhere, and ∫X dμ=0. Then for every real s>0, exp((exp(s)−s−1)∫X² dμ)−∫exp(sX) dμ is positive semidefinite. The explicit regularity hypotheses expand Tropp§2.2 standing expectations. The claim is the real normalized individual-matrix form of Lemma6.7.
assumptions: Public scope: a probability space \((\Omega,\Sigma,\mu)\), a finite nonempty index set \(\mathcal I\), and a real random square matrix \(X:\Omega\to\operatorname{Mat}_{\mathcal I}(\mathbb R)\). The integral is Bochner integration and \(e^A\) is the matrix-algebra power series. The order \(U\preceq V\) means that \(V-U\) is positive semidefinite as a full quadratic form.

Public hypotheses: \(X=X^\top\) and \(X\preceq I\) almost surely, \(\int X\,d\mu=0\), and \(s>0\). The cap is one-sided. The matrix need not be positive semidefinite and negative eigenvalues are unrestricted.

Explicit source-standing regularity: \(X\) is almost-everywhere strongly measurable, \(\int\|X\|\,d\mu<\infty\), and \(\int\|X^2\|\,d\mu<\infty\). These make Tropp§2.2's sufficiently-regular expectation convention explicit for the actual first and second matrix expectations. The exponential integrability needed in the proof is derived from the cap.

\(X^2=X\cdot X\) is the ordinary matrix square. The exponent uses its actual matrix expectation \(\int X^2\,d\mu\), with coefficient \(e^s-s-1\). No scalar variance proxy or matrix covariance upper cover replaces that expectation.

steps.text: For a self-adjoint A≼I, the spectrum lies below1. On that same spectrum, exp(sx)≤exp(s), so continuous functional calculus bounds the matrix exponential norm. A second scalar comparison, 1+x≤exp(x), gives I+H≼exp(H) for a self-adjoint H. Both arguments compare scalar functions of one fixed matrix.

# 数学重构

## 对象与所有定义

令 d,q 为自然数，满足 2q+1<d。下面逐项展开输入中的全部 let 绑定。记 I={0,…,d−1}=Fin d，J={0,…,q}=Fin(q+1)。所有 i、k、b 等指标的数值均从零起算。

D 是 ℝ^d 的欧氏空间 EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)，E 是 ℝ^(q+1) 的欧氏空间 EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin(q+1))。Ω=J→D 是由 q+1 个 D 向量组成的样本空间。一个样本 ω 可以写成实数数组 g_{b,i}=(ω(b))_i，其中 b∈J、i∈I。μ=⊗_{b∈J}γ_d 是 Ω 上的有限乘积测度，其中 γ_d 是均值为零、协方差为单位矩阵的标准高斯概率测度。用实数组坐标表示，μ 的密度是 (2π)^(−d(q+1)/2) exp(−(1/2)∑_{b∈J}∑_{i∈I}g_{b,i}²)，相对于全部坐标的乘积 Lebesgue 测度。标准高斯定义与乘积测度意味着这些坐标是相互独立的 N(0,1) 坐标；这是已给定测度的展开，不是额外的分布假设。

r 是实数 q+1，即先取自然数 q+1 再转成实数。L=2r+3 log(1000d)，其中 d 在此转成实数，log 是自然对数。对 i∈I，θ_i=(i+1−1/2)π/d=(i+1/2)π/d。确定性函数 t_i:J→ℝ 的坐标为 t_{i,0}=1；当 1≤k≤q 时，t_{i,k}=√2 cos(kθ_i)。这里 √2 是非负平方根。

row_i(ω) 是 E 中坐标为 (g_{b,i})_{b∈J} 的向量；WithLp.toLp 2 只是把这些坐标包装为欧氏向量，WithLp.ofLp 则取回相同坐标。因此 ‖row_i(ω)‖²=∑_{b∈J}g_{b,i}²。记 C_i(ω) 为这个和不大于 L 的条件；等号被纳入截断保留区域。

Y_i(ω) 是以 J×J 同时为行、列指标的实方阵。若 C_i(ω) 成立，Y_i(ω)=d^(−1)(g_i g_i^T)⊗(t_i t_i^T)；若不成立，Y_i(ω)=0，其中 g_i=(g_{b,i})_{b∈J}。这里外积 u v^T 的 (a,c) 元为 u_a v_c。Kronecker 乘积的因子顺序确切为先 g_i g_i^T、后 t_i t_i^T。因此，对于行 (b,k)、列 (c,ℓ)，

(Y_i(ω))_{(b,k),(c,ℓ)} = d^(−1) 1_{C_i(ω)} g_{b,i}g_{c,i}t_{i,k}t_{i,ℓ}。

等价地，把 h_i(ω)∈ℝ^(J×J) 的 (b,k) 元定义为 g_{b,i}t_{i,k}，则 Y_i(ω)=d^(−1)1_{C_i(ω)}h_i(ω)h_i(ω)^T。这个 h_i 和 C_i 只是本重构用于展开原表达式的缩写。

mean_i=∫_Ω Y_i(ω) dμ(ω) 是每个 i 自己的未条件化均值矩阵；其 (b,k),(c,ℓ) 元是 d^(−1)∫_Ω1_{C_i(ω)}g_{b,i}g_{c,i}t_{i,k}t_{i,ℓ} dμ(ω)。Z_i(ω)=Y_i(ω)−mean_i 是按这个均值逐矩阵相减得到的中心化矩阵。ρ=2r(L+1)/d 是实数。确定性实权重 w_i=cos((2q+1)θ_i)，其中 2q+1 先在自然数中计算再转为实数。最后 X_i(ω)=ρ^(−1)(w_i Z_i(ω))=(w_i/ρ)(Y_i(ω)−mean_i)。权重 w_i 按其带符号的原值乘整个中心化矩阵；没有取绝对值、平方或重新归一化。这些 w_i 不改变 μ，也不是概率混合权重。

为展开结论，再记 V_i=∫_Ω X_i(ω)X_i(ω) dμ(ω)，α(s)=e^s−s−1，M_{i,s}=exp(α(s)V_i)−∫_Ωexp(sX_i(ω)) dμ(ω)。这三个符号是本重构的缩写。乘积 X_i(ω)X_i(ω) 是通常矩阵乘法；其 (b,k),(c,ℓ) 元为 ∑_{a∈J}∑_{h∈J}(X_i(ω))_{(b,k),(a,h)}(X_i(ω))_{(a,h),(c,ℓ)}。V_i 对这些乘积取矩阵 Bochner 积分。exp(A)=∑_{m=0}^∞A^m/m! 是有限矩阵代数中的收敛幂级数，A^0 是大小 (q+1)² 的单位矩阵。Real.exp s=e^s 是标量指数，矩阵 exp 不是逐元素指数。

## 取值域

d,q∈ℕ，包含 q=0 的情况，且唯一给定的数值条件是 2q+1<d。I=Fin d，J=Fin(q+1)；D 和 E 各自具有欧氏范数与 Borel 可测结构。Ω=J→D 带有限乘积可测结构和上述高斯乘积概率测度 μ。每个 Y_i、mean_i、Z_i、X_i、V_i、M_{i,s} 都属于 M_{J×J}(ℝ)，即 (q+1)²×(q+1)² 实矩阵。检验正半定性的向量属于 ℝ^(J×J)。全部矩阵运算及 Bochner 积分使用有限维实欧氏算子范数拓扑。r,L,ρ,θ_i,t_{i,k},w_i 为实数或实坐标，s∈ℝ。所有实数逆元按输入采用零处取零的总定义。

## 量词

对所有自然数 d,q，只要 2q+1<d，按前槽的全部定义固定 D、E、Ω、μ、r、L、θ、t、row、Y、mean、Z、ρ、w、X 后，对每个实数 s，如果 s>0，则对每个 i∈Fin d，有下一槽的矩阵不等式。结论是逐 i 的全称命题；它没有对 i 求和，也没有在 i 中随机抽取一个指标。正半定性内部再全称量化所有向量 v∈ℝ^(J×J)。所有积分的 ω 在 Ω 上绑定；ω 不是另一个自由的、须对其逐点证明最终不等式的参数。

## 明确假设与推导性质的边界

签名明确给定的假设只有 d,q 为自然数、2q+1<d，以及结论参数的 s>0。样本空间、分布、向量、截断、均值、归一化和权重均由 let 定义固定；它们不是另行量化的任意数据。特别地，没有额外输入一个一般随机矩阵的对称性假设、上谱界假设、零均值假设或可积性假设。

从自然数条件可以推导 d≥2q+2≥2，r=q+1≥1，log(1000d)>0，因而 L>0、ρ>0。这些是可推导的数值性质，没有被添加成独立假设。由构造可以识别 Y_i 为截断的实外积矩阵，因此它对称且正半定；w_i 满足 −1≤w_i≤1。这些也是定义的可推导性质，不是额外假设，也不应把它们当作替代最终矩阵指数结论的陈述。

输入明确要求按所写命题重构，因此本重构不增补任何可积性前提或可积性结论。所有出现的积分均为定义中显示的 Bochner 积分；按照给定上下文，这个积分在不可积时总定义为零。这里没有隐含的条件高斯分布，也没有把 μ 重新定义为截断事件上的归一化测度。

## 结论

对每个 s>0 和每个 i∈I，M_{i,s} 正半定，也就是

exp((e^s−s−1)∫_Ω X_i(ω)X_i(ω) dμ(ω)) − ∫_Ω exp(sX_i(ω)) dμ(ω) ≽ 0。

正半定性完整地要求 M_{i,s}^T=M_{i,s}，并对每个 v∈ℝ^(J×J) 有

∑_{b,k∈J}∑_{c,ℓ∈J}v_{(b,k)}(M_{i,s})_{(b,k),(c,ℓ)}v_{(c,ℓ)}≥0。

所以也可以按矩阵序写为 ∫_Ω exp(sX_i(ω)) dμ(ω)≼exp((e^s−s−1)V_i)。这个结论保留上面定义中 X_i 的原样符号权重 w_i、截断与中心化。它是完整矩阵的比较，没有逐元素比较、取迹、最大特征值或尾概率表达式，也没有出现 exp(s∑_iX_i) 或任何对 i 的矩阵和。

## 作用域与运算解释

每个 let 定义都作用于其后整个命题：D、E 决定后续空间；Ω、μ 决定 Y、mean 以及最终所有积分的样本空间和测度；r、L 决定截断与 ρ；θ、t 决定确定性外积因子；mean 在 Z 中先按同一个 i 取全体 Ω 的积分；Z、ρ、w 再决定 X。先定义的对象不依赖后来才量化的 s。

row_i(ω) 使用固定 i 处跨 b∈J 的坐标。t_{i,k} 中 k=0 的分支是依据 k 的零起算自然数值判断。Y_i 的 if 分支只依据 ∑_b g_{b,i}²≤L；条件不成立时赋零矩阵，不删除该样本。1_{C_i} 只是这一分支的指示函数记法，不是条件测度。mean_i 和最终两个积分始终使用原始全空间乘积测度 μ。

矩阵行 (b,k)、列 (c,ℓ) 的第一个分量索引高斯行向量坐标，第二个分量索引确定性三角函数向量坐标。乘法中的 a,h 仅是对 J×J 的局部求和指标。Bochner 积分内的 ω 是绑定变量，i 与 s 在积分内固定。截断条件中的 ≤ 包含边界。s•X_i 是实标量乘矩阵，exp 使用完整矩阵幂。自然数转实数不改变 d、q、q+1 或 2q+1 的数值。原签名中的全部 let 已在 objects 槽展开；新增的 I、J、g、C、h、V、α、M 仅便于表达相同对象，不引入新的自由参数。

## 常数依赖

固定数值常数为 0、1、2、3、1000、π，及由其定义的 √2。d,q 是仅有的自由维数参数，并受 2q+1<d 约束。D 依赖 d；E、J、r 依赖 q；Ω、μ 依赖 d,q。L=2(q+1)+3log(1000d) 与 ρ=2(q+1)(L+1)/d 仅依赖 d,q。θ_i 依赖 d,i；t_{i,k} 在它的定义域内依赖 d,q,i,k；row_i 依赖 d,q,i,ω。Y_i 依赖 d,q,i,ω；mean_i 依赖 d,q,i 及已经由 d,q 固定的 μ；Z_i 和 X_i 依赖 d,q,i,ω。w_i=cos((2q+1)(i+1/2)π/d) 依赖 d,q,i，且没有额外可选择的权重参数。V_i 依赖 d,q,i，α(s) 只依赖 s，M_{i,s} 依赖 d,q,i,s。全部这些依赖均由精确定义指定，没有未定常数、隐藏的概率参数、额外截断半径或可优化的归一化因子。
